article.title: Witness protection scheme
article.content: Every State Government shall prepare and notify a Witness Protection Scheme for the State with a view to ensure protection of the witnesses.
article.html:
398Witness protection scheme

Section 398 · Chapter XXIX

Every State Government shall prepare and notify a Witness Protection Scheme for the State with a view to ensure protection of the witnesses.
